reviews.body: An idea: It would be really cool if Charm had an option where we could upload our face so the AI knows which person in a photo is actually us. Sometimes I post photos of another person but the AI comments assume that person is me because it doesn't know the difference. Maybe there could be a face recognition or character profile feature where we can mark, “This is me,” and add other recurring people's faces or characters too. That way, the AI could recognise different faces.

reviews.body: Edited: Coming from Butterflies AI, I had hope for this app, but as usual, there's too much behind a paywall & free does so little. Butterflies AI clearly spoiled me.
